arguments.command:
@'
import ast
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from threading import Lock
path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\native_runtime.py')
source = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
compile(source, str(path), 'exec')
def method(text):
    tree = ast.parse(text)
    cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'NativeRuntime')
    node = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'http_summary')
    namespace = {}
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), '<summary>', 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace['http_summary']
old = method(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + path.as_posix()], text=True))
new = method(source)
runtime = SimpleNamespace(_http_lock=Lock(), _http_records={}, _http_total=0, _http_primary=0, _http_control=0, _http_overflow=0, _http_journal_complete=True)
for states in [[], ['waiter_timeout', 'responded', 'waiter_timeout', 'cancelled']]:
    runtime._http_records = {i: dict(state=state, dispatched=True, rejected_before_dispatch=False, operation_error=True, route='/control/recover', handled=False) for i, state in enumerate(states)}
    expected = old(runtime)
    assert new(runtime) == expected
    assert new(runtime, include_waiter_timeouts=False) == expected
    actual = new(runtime, include_waiter_timeouts=True)
    assert actual == dict(expected, waiter_timeouts=states.count('waiter_timeout'))
    assert type(actual['waiter_timeouts']) is int
runtime._http_records[0]['state'] = 'responded'
assert new(runtime, include_waiter_timeouts=True)['waiter_timeouts'] == 1
try:
    new(runtime, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('Parameter must be keyword-only')
print('Focused summary checks passed')
'@ | python -B -; git diff --check; git --no-pager diff --stat; git status --short
